queries: KFF 2026 adults AI chatbots medical health advice survey

sources_considered.why: Original survey publisher reports prevalence, substantive medical use, fieldwork and sampling.
Read the full findings and methodology to verify the survey denominator and scope.
June 2026 findings concern a later population state than the post.

evidence_items.locator: Opening findings; Many AI Users Upload Personal Health Information Despite Privacy Concerns; methodology paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: The nationally representative survey of 1,343 U.S. adults found 32% had sought chatbot health information in the preceding year; 13% had uploaded medical information for personalized explanations or advice. Fieldwork ended March 2, with a full-sample sampling margin of approximately three percentage points.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a worldwide or all-ages prevalence.
The headline prevalence combines health information with advice rather than measuring only individualized treatment recommendations.
